description: This PHP source file implements an API for device connection management, handling request types, token generation and validation, and setting device parameters related to Wi-Fi DPP (Device Provisioning Protocol). It includes functions for processing POST requests, generating and validating tokens, and managing device-specific configurations.

methods.name: getKey
methods.description: Generates or retrieves a cryptographic key for token encryption. It reads from specific key files, creates new keys if necessary, and ensures key files are properly managed.

methods.name: genToken
methods.description: Creates an encrypted token containing the expiration timestamp, used for authenticating subsequent API requests.

methods.name: validateToken
methods.description: Decrypts and verifies the provided token, checking if it is still valid based on expiration.

methods.name: processPostRequest
methods.description: Handles device provisioning via POST request, parsing DPP URI data, validating MAC addresses, generating configuration parameters, and setting device attributes.

methods.name: getHeaderValue
methods.description: Retrieves the value of a specified HTTP header from the request.

methods.name: authenticateCaller
methods.description: Performs authentication by verifying tokens or challenge responses, and may generate tokens upon successful authentication.
